title: 3D Waifu Assistant On Your Desktop With ChatGPT Voice
description:
Your desktop can have a 3D waifu assistant that talks in ChatGPT's voice 🔥

It lip syncs to the audio, and you can drop in any VRM model with your own emotions and animations. Hook it to Codex and the character actually waves and reacts to commands ✨

Works on Windows, macOS and Linux. Setup guide exists but you'll tinker a bit 😅

GitHub: xikhar persona

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
